supabaseUrl.title: Supabase URL
supabaseUrl.description: Your Supabase project URL. Falls back to SUPABASE_URL env var.

supabaseKey.title: Supabase Service Role Key
supabaseKey.description: Supabase service role key. Falls back to SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY env var.

sampleSize.title: Sample Size
sampleSize.description: Total number of roles to audit. Half drawn from low-confidence, half random. Default: 100.

confidenceThreshold.title: Confidence Threshold
confidenceThreshold.description: Roles with confidence below this value are included in the low-confidence sample. Default: 0.75.
